findings.reason: the gate closes on an extension whose replays never ran, so §8 would draw a verdict from an unchanged population, which is the exact defect the section exists to fix.
findings.text: §17's done-when is "every run it lists has a promoted ledger row carrying its gate verdict", but the file it names lists, as committed (docs/evidence/fragments/workers-spend-fewer-tokens-per-landed-node/paired-replay-assignment-2.json), only each section's original landed run id under `runs` plus its base and stratum, and names no replay id at all: all ten of those original runs already carry promoted ledger rows, so the measure is satisfied with zero of the seventy replays dispatched, and the stated negative control ("a replay whose ledger row is missing … leaves this section open") can never fire because no replay is listed

findings.reason: removal deletes a shipped treatment's code, so a removal branch that cannot be evaluated either never fires on a real regression or forces the node to invent an unstated yardstick.
findings.text: §8's removal rule reads "A treatment is removed … when its mean paired cumulative input per run rises, or its gate pass rate falls, by a paired difference whose interval is separated from its baseline's same-arm spread", but the same-arm spread is defined only for cumulative input (line 108: "reported as its mean paired difference in cumulative input with a paired bootstrap 90% interval"), and §14's committed record carries the same-arm column for input only, so the gate-pass-rate branch has no interval to compare against

findings.reason: the stream resolves at the named path, so a coordinator finds it and at most re-records a fixture, which costs a run but changes no mechanism.
findings.text: §8's positive control still reads "No such stream exists yet; before the node is dispatched the coordinator records one … and commits it at docs/research/fixtures/codex-refused-patch-stream.jsonl", while that path resolves now and the section's own record (c-s8-codex-fixture, 2026-11-11) says the fixture was recorded there

response_events.note: s17's done-when now requires a replays map on each section of paired-replay-assignment-2.json naming the run id of each of its seven arms (added as each replay is dispatched), all seven ids or an exclusion per section, and a promoted ledger row with a gate verdict for every named id; the negative control fires on a section short of seven ids or a named replay without a verdict. The committed file now carries the map for the three replays already dispatched.

The gate-pass-rate branch of the removal rule now has its own yardstick: a treatment is removed when its gate pass rate falls below its baseline's by more than the gap between the same-arm replicate's pass rate and the baseline's over the same sections. The input branch keeps the paired interval against the same-arm spread.
The positive control now states that the stream is recorded at docs/research/fixtures/codex-refused-patch-stream.jsonl, from a headless codex run whose apply_patch was given a stale context.
